# The Onslaught System Explained

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Mar 11, 2025
- 5 min read

Updated: Apr 5, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_33b3c1eb8f7844a2b9d1bafba3fb929f~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

__What is the Onslaught System and How Does it Work?__

The Onslaught System is a combat mechanic that increases damage based on the number of active stacks you have, granting a +5% damage boost per stack. This 5% increase is calculated from the buffed Pip-Boy damage number, meaning the damage numbers go up or down with any active buffs or modifiers affecting your weapon's displayed damage.

Players begin with zero stacks and must either equip a Furious weapon or use specific perk cards to activate and use the system. Stacks accumulate when you hit an enemy, but misses do not count.

Over time, stacks are lost at a rate of one per second unless refreshed by landing additional hits. The way stacks are gained and lost depends on the weapons and perks a player is using, making it important to choose the right loadout to maintain Onslaught effectively. Keeping a steady attack rhythm, such as using automatic weapons, is essential for maximizing damage output and making the most of this system.

You can see your active Onslaught stacks in the bottom right corner of your screen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dfa169f98175422a8c16637038a06b17~mv2.jpg)

Onslaught is additive. If you have a Furious weapon and the perk card Guerrilla Master (5 stacks) equipped, and your Pip-Boy damage is showing as 228, then the damage formula would be:

**Furious Weapon Bonus**

11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) = 102.6 (45%)

PLUS

**Guerrilla Master Bonus**

11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) + 11.4 (5%) = 57 (25%)

**Total bonus damage:**

102.6 + 57 = 159.6 (70%)

So, your total damage would be 228 + 159.6 = 387.6, reflecting a 70% increase in damage output.

__How to Activate Onslaught__

Onslaught becomes active as soon as you meet one of the following conditions:

- **Equipping a Furious weapon** – This automatically enables Onslaught.
- **Equipping Onslaught-related perk cards** – Increases the maximum number of Onslaught stacks. However, unless you have a Furious weapon equipped, these cards will only grant their primary bonus (e.g., +1% reload speed) and not the secondary effect (e.g., +3 stacks of 5% damage each).

__Standard and Master Onslaught__

There are two types of Onslaught, Standard and Master

**Standard Onslaught** 

- Players gain 1 stack per **hit** and lose 1 stack per second.
- The Furious Legendary Prefix, Guerrilla Expert, Guerrilla Master & Gunslinger Expert are all part of the Standard Onslaught System
- Works best with faster fire rate weapons, such as automatic weapons, that can refill stacks as quickly as they are lost.

**Master Onslaught**

- Players lose 1 stack per **hit** but also regain 1 stack per second without needing to hit an enemy
- Furious Legendary Prefix and Gunslinger Master is part of the Master Onslaught System
- Works best with slow-firing, single-shot weapons or heavy guns fired from the hip, allowing stacks to refill between shots.
- Automatic weapons burn through stacks too quickly, making them ineffective with this perk.

Onslaught applies to melee weapons only when they have the Furious Legendary Prefix.

- Standard Onslaught Perk Cards do not affect or add to your stacks.
- Master Onslaught Perk Cards do not add to your stacks, but they do change the stack counter to refill 1 stack per second.

When the perk card Ricochet activates, it will register as a hit on an enemy and add to or remove a stack.

__Furious Legendary Prefix__

- When equipped, a Furious weapon will add +9 stacks.
- Each stack increases damage by +5%, capping at 45% extra damage (9 × 5%).
- These stacks and bonus damage, stack with Onslaught perk cards.
- Each hit refills 1 stack.
- Stacks disappear at a rate of 1 per second.

__Shotguns and Explosive Weapons__

Shotguns and explosive weapons work differently with Onslaught because they can gain multiple stacks per shot. However, they are still subject to the stack cap and lose 1 stack per second unless Gunslinger Master is equipped.

- Each pellet in a shotgun blast gives 1 stack.
- Each hit from an explosive projectile gives 1 stack.
- Example (Shotgun): If a shotgun fires 8 pellets and all of them hit, that results in 8 stacks per shot.

__Onslaught Perk Cards__

Onslaught perk cards can be used individually or stacked together for greater effect.

Each perk card provides a primary buff, such as increased reload speed or extra damage to close-range enemies, while also granting additional Onslaught stacks as a secondary buff.

Each stack increases damage by 5%, meaning the more stacks you accumulate, the higher your overall damage output.

**Guerrilla Expert**

Perk Point Cost: 2

Onslaught Stacks Added: 3

Stacks with Speed Demon Mutation

- **Primary Effect:**
 - +1% reload speed per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +20% reload speed
- **Secondary Effect (requires Furious weapon equipped):**
 - +5% damage per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +100% damage

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_22e72564af5a44a1a1e008284d95ff49~mv2.jpg)

**Guerrilla Master**

Perk Point Cost: 3

Onslaught Stacks Added: 5

Stacks with other Damage to Close Enemies perk cards

- **Primary Effect:**
 - +5% ranged damage to close enemies (within 40 feet) per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +100% ranged damage to close enemies
- **Secondary Effect (requires Furious weapon equipped):**
 - +5% damage per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +100% damage

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a87b872ee5c84f5893f2064909f8ad83~mv2.jpg)

**Gunslinger Expert**

Perk Point Cost: 2

Onslaught Stacks Added: 3

Stacks with other Weak Spot Damage perk cards

- **Primary Effect:**
 - +1% weak spot damage (dark yellow damage numbers) per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +20% weak spot damage
- **Secondary Effect (requires Furious weapon equipped):**
 - +5% damage per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +100% damage

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_95c1b90b480842f59576e7f732d67db9~mv2.jpg)

**Gunslinger Master**

Perk Point Cost: 3

Onslaught Stacks Added: 10

- **Primary Effect (requires Furious weapon equipped):**
 - +5% damage per Onslaught stack
 - e.g., 20 stacks = +100% damage
- **Secondary Effect:**
 - None

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_643e70e16cbf401aa689d7d125759245~mv2.jpg)

__Stack Combinations and Max Stacks__

**Standard Onslaught System**

- Furious
- = 9 Max Stacks → 9 × 5% = +45% damage per hit

- Furious (9) +
- Guerrilla Expert (3) +
- Guerrilla Master (5) +
- Gunslinger Expert (3)
- = 20 Max Stacks → 20 × 5% = +100% damage per hit

**Master Onslaught System**

- Furious (9) +
- Guerrilla Expert (3) +
- Guerrilla Master (5) +
- Gunslinger Expert (3) +
- Gunslinger Master (10)
- = 30 Max Stacks → 30 × 5% = +150% damage per hit
